name: loadout
description: @loadout chat participant: routes each request to the local model, Claude Code or Codex, and spends subscription quota only when needed.

chatParticipants.name: loadout
chatParticipants.description: Picks the local model, Claude or Codex for each request

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show subscription windows and loadout's recent calls

loadout.allowEdits.description: Let backends edit files in the workspace. Off: Claude runs in plan mode and Codex read-only.

loadout.codexEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for frontier work.

loadout.frontier.description: balance: send frontier work to whichever subscription has more room left after its reserve, counting both its 5-hour and weekly windows.

loadout.claudeReserve.description: Share of Claude's 5-hour and weekly windows kept for your own Claude Code sessions. Headless calls share those windows with you; once only this much is left, @loadout sends frontier work to Codex.

loadout.codexReserve.description: Share of Codex's windows kept for your own Codex sessions.
